versions.changelog:
Kagi skill v0.1.0

- Initial release: Integrates Kagi Search API and FastGPT for enhanced web research.
- Provides Python scripts for both ranked search results and LLM-powered web answers with citations.
- Supports programmatic web search and summarization via command-line interface.
- Includes setup instructions for API token usage and example commands.
- Suggested as an alternative when Brave Search is rate-limited or higher-quality results are needed.
